summary_1line: Aged King Dasaratha, reflecting on Rama’s exceptional virtues, decides to crown him heir and summons a council of princes and nobles.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha sits in his palace reflecting on his old age while gazing with pride at the radiant Prince Rama standing before the court.
Rama, noble and serene like a full moon among people, is surrounded by citizens and sages who look upon him with deep love and reverence.
The aged king summons ministers and visiting princes into a grand hall of Ayodhya to announce his wish to crown Rama as heir-apparent.
